svg.text: Drag this into Figma first. Use it as a reference to arrange all 45 SVG wireframes.
Each box = one SVG file. Arrows show navigation flow. Colors = flow groups.

g.text: Shown when 7-day trial expires and user is not subscribed.
Blocks entire app. Must subscribe or restore.
3-tab NavigationStack — root of the app after onboarding
SHARED DETAIL SCREENS (Pushed from Home or Explore tabs)
SETTINGS (Sheet from Home tab gear icon)
Force Update + Maintenance block the entire app.
Billing banner is non-blocking overlay on Home.
Drag 00-FLOW-MAP.svg into the "Flow Map" page. This is your master reference.
For each page, drag the matching SVG files. Arrange left-to-right in numbered order:
• "Onboarding" page: drag all onboarding--*.svg files (01 through 09, left to right)
• "Home" page: place 01-home-main and 02-home-scroll side by side, then sheets below them
• "Details" page: arrange all 8 detail screens in a 4x2 grid
• "Components" page: all 7 component sheets in a row — these are your design system reference
